task.wonder_pick.label: Wonder Pick
task.wonder_pick.description: Complete one Wonder Pick using a high-rarity, low-rarity, or specified-card strategy. Hourglasses and Poke Gold are never used.
option.wonder_pick_strategy.label: Selection Strategy
option.wonder_pick_strategy.description: The strategy selects a five-card group. The top-center card is picked consistently; the task does not claim to predict the shuffle.
Select a 3- or 4-stamina group to pursue one-star-or-higher cards.
option.wonder_pick_strategy.low_rarity.d: Select only 1-stamina groups to pursue diamond-one / diamond-two cards.
option.wonder_pick_strategy.specified_ca: Select only groups whose card text matches a configured OCR target.
option.wonder_pick_targets.label: Target Card Names
option.wonder_pick_targets.description: Shown only for Specified Cards. Separate multiple names with |.
option.wonder_pick_targets.input.label: Names or regular expression
option.wonder_pick_targets.input.descrip: Example: Sylveon|Slowpoke. Use the language currently displayed by the game.
option.wonder_pick_targets.input.error: Enter 1 to 80 characters without newlines or braces.
option.wonder_pick_save_result.label: Save Obtained Card Screenshot
option.wonder_pick_save_result.descripti: Enabled by default. Images are stored under records/wonder_pick/date/ in the application directory.
task.claim_gifts.label: [WIP] Claim Gifts
task.claim_gifts.description: Claim uncollected and unexpired Gifts. This is currently a skeleton flow.
task.shop_free.label: [WIP] Shop Freebies
task.shop_free.description: Check daily free shop items, event exchanges, and premium freebies. This is currently a skeleton flow.
task.claim_missions.label: [WIP] Claim Mission Rewards
task.claim_missions.description: Claim daily, event, and premium mission rewards. This is currently a skeleton flow.
task.solo_battle.label: [WIP] Solo Battle
task.solo_battle.description: Enter Solo Battle. Future work can automate rewards, surrender loops, or basic battle strategy.
task.versus_battle.label: [WIP] Versus Battle
task.versus_battle.description: Enter Versus, Ranked, or Private Match. Versus automation should be conservative around reconnects and strategy.
task.share_card.label: [WIP] Share Card
task.share_card.description: Use Social Hub Share to send a card to a friend. The feature unlocks after 14 days and recipients have daily limits.
task.trade_card.label: [WIP] Trade Card
task.trade_card.description: Use Social Hub Trade with friends. The feature unlocks after 14 days and only one trade can be active at a time.
